The 008 hex justification cites a value-file line for a keychain read

noveltyJustification: Both findings are new to this lineage and neither refines an earlier one: no prior iteration examined the encoded forms the leak scan matches or the citation behind the hex addition. Weighted new 2 (two P2) of weighted total 2.

title: The 008 encoded-forms guard names three additions where the reference it cites matches eight forms
The 008 hex justification cites a value-file line for a keychain read

detail: R4-P2-001 is incomplete-recommendation: the row is accurate about the four base64 forms and its guard omits two of the eight forms the cited function returns. R4-P2-002 is citation-scope: the guard is right and the sentence that justifies it rests on a line about value files rather than keychain items. Neither is a P1 because the row wording is not false and the guard still closes three of the five missing forms.

direction: The 008 pitfall 2 row as a false claim
reason: The reference does build the four base64 forms and the plan does miss them; the citation is accurate and only the guard completeness fails.

direction: The 011 clean-room pitfall as a rule violation
reason: Wave 0 reads the tinychannels source and wave 1 writes the module, so the 003 rule is not literally broken; the row claims only that the rule is not carried, which the lines support.

direction: The 004 and 010 no-row entries as unsearched gaps
reason: Both sections state the absence as a search, and the 004 section names the one change it does recommend.
